name: Long binary colorings without four-term progressions
description: construct() -> a list of integer colors 0 or 1, length between k=4 and maximum=512. No nonconstant four-term arithmetic progression of positions may be monochromatic. Maximize length. state_of_the_art.statement: W(2,4) = 35 (Chvátal 1970; OEIS A005346), so the longest 2-colouring without a monochromatic four-term progression has length 34. An exhaustive search (scripts/check_state_of_the_art.py) reproduces both the length-34 colouring and the impossibility at 35.
